prompt: Clearly and concisely describe the process of using thematic content analysis - from coding to themes (1 paragraph)
judge_reasoning: Candidate 1 most directly and clearly describes the process of thematic content analysis specifically from coding through to identifying and defining themes, doing so in a single concise paragraph. Candidate 4 covers relevant steps (searching/reviewing themes and defining/naming them), but it is far more than “1 paragraph” and extends beyond the requested coding-to-themes focus. Candidate 3 largely reframes the task as a TCA vs. grounded theory comparison and incorrectly characterizes axial/selective coding as part of TCA’s core process. Candidate 2 does not provide the requested coding-to-themes procedure, focusing instead on advantages and limitations.
